title: Ulla, son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 42a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.42a.6-8) regarding a halakhic matter, and Rava raises a difficulty against him.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Ulla the title Rav, which is absent from Hyman’s notice. Ulla proposes a reading of the verse about the ox’s owner. Rava objects and offers a different explanation.
